exposure_environment: unenrolled default (no Bridge enrollment, no enabled commands, no high-risk certification)

families.notes: Signed manifest, capability states with the pinned contract revision and live Bridge discovery (cached as runtime snapshots), datasets, sync status, liveness/readiness.
14 reports with source, grain, units, scope, coverage and freshness; unavailable sources answer explicit blockers, never invented values.
Bounded, scoped, stably sorted reads of exact pinned collections with opaque continuation tokens bound to staff/scope/filters; every read audited.
Typed commands only; durable intent and audit before one dispatch; UNKNOWN_OUTCOME settled only by owner readback; R3/R4 need certification, runtime availability and an independent approval.
Stage A Bridge feed/ACK (worker) and Stage B derived HQ outbox, ACKs, snapshots and partition/quarantine/gap status.
Read-oriented HQ interface; the Bridge adapter uses the source's real POST method. Per-currency minor units, never summed across currencies, wallet movement never revenue.
Cases, SOS queue, case events/evidence (classified), controlled native actions through governed operations with owner readback.
Cases, stages, findings; decisions only through the source's independent decision workflow; automated recommendations are never approvals.
Campaign intents, readback and cancellation; consent rechecked by the source; LOGGED_ONLY never reported as delivered. The HQ Marketing module remains the group-wide marketing application.
Register, read, record fulfilment; fulfilled only on source-native confirmation; local erasure only after an owner-confirmed fulfilment and never under legal hold.
Scoped export creation (R3: certification + independent approval); single-use, short-lived download through the source; download tokens never stored or returned in receipts.
